architecture.scope: Host-side kernel-image admission and boot-contract validator with C ABI routines and Python verification utilities.
architecture.runtime_boundary: Runs before the kernel handoff; does not replace firmware/bootloader and does not execute the image.
architecture.composition_rule: Keep binary parsing, memory-map validation, diagnostics and policy gates separated behind fixed-size, versioned contracts.

components.responsibility: Validate fixed-size image headers, architecture fields and entry offsets.
Host-side inspection and verification workflow for E2K-target image metadata.
Report validation states and reasons without transferring control.

dependencies.relationship: image format and boot-info contract counterpart

preserved_boundaries: Image validation, firmware handoff and kernel execution are separate phases.
Memory maps are caller-supplied and bounded.
Host-side success does not prove firmware compatibility or physical boot.
forbidden_composition: No image execution or hidden handoff from validation routines.
No unsigned image treated as authenticated.
gaps: Run image validation against a corpus of malformed and valid fixtures on supported hosts.
Record actual boot-chain/firmware interoperability separately from header validation.
